tools.name: wever_delegated-authority

tools.description:
Paid URL: 2.00 USDC per mandate on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Only issue_mandate is billed; GET, contract reads, drafts and all other modes have no x402 fee. Credentials and grants remain required for their existing operations. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Issue signed mandates and approve an exact action. The named agent uses its grant to create an immutable work-order record.
Operating boundary: The operator issues a mandate, then approves an action grant lasting up to 300 seconds. The credentialed agent consumes the grant once to create one work-order record. Inspect the same grant until its result is final. Mandate issuance costs 2 USDC after the free calls are used, except that Wever absorbs the issuance cost of a mandate whose every scope is money_back_case during the money-back operator launch. Reads, drafts, the public read-only inspect_mandate status check and other authority modes use their existing credentials at no access fee. Work execution, delivery and payment each use their own service.
POST /api/delegated-authority. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. This current operation is a credentialed authority control plane for immutable work-order record creation. It does not execute the recorded work, deliver results, or authorize payment. Operator issuance and grant approval require X-Wever-Operator-Key and Idempotency-Key; consumption requires the target agent's X-Wever-Agent-Key. Usage and attribution come from validated credentials and durable authority records. AP2 issuance also accepts issue_mandate with mandate.profile com.weverlabs.ap2.direct-checkout.1, the holder public key, signed checkout challenge, consent digest and bounded expiry. It requires a dedicated AP2 issuer credential in X-Wever-Operator-Key, Idempotency-Key and a fresh holder wallet proof. Issuance costs 2.00 USDC per issued mandate; verification at /api/ap2-mandate-gateway costs 0.10 USDC per call, subject to the same shared free allowance. The AP2 mandate records checkout intent and grants no tool access, execution authority or spending authority.

tools.name: wever_referral-rail
tools.title: Referral rail
tools.description: Create a rail-signed WL-R-XXXXXX referral code, permanently attribute your own wallet with a signed code_token, inspect earnings, claim USDC, or verify a signed referral receipt. POST /api/referral-rail. Every call requires X-Wever-Wallet-Proof signed by the caller wallet and bound to the exact request body. Attribution requires the referee wallet proof, rejects self-referrals and permits only the first code. Earnings accrue from verified real payment and settlement records: 20 percent of eligible USDC paid for 12 months from the first attributed paid call. Claims reserve earnings and create a linked payout instruction for the authenticated referrer wallet, require a stable claim_id for retries, and allow 1.00 to 25.00 USDC per claim. Optional amount_usdc requests an exact amount within the available balance; omit it to claim the available balance up to 25 USDC. The treasury holder uses wever_payout-authorize and wever_payout-execute with AP2 holder binding v2 and separate EIP-712 spending consent. The dedicated payout wallet requires manual funding; the shared payout cap is 100 USDC per UTC day.
